data.one_liner: Helper library adding readable control-flow and data manipulation extensions
data.what_it_does: Dartlin provides extension methods for control flow (iff, when, tryy) and data manipulation (range, zipWithNext, etc.) to make Dart code more readable.
use_when: replacing switch statements with expression-based when
avoid_when: performance-critical code where benchmarks are needed
code that requires fine-grained control over execution order beyond what extensions provide
strengths: wide range of extensions for collections, control flow, and data manipulation
weaknesses: may duplicate existing Dart collection operators
data.minimal_example:
import 'package:dartlin/dartlin.dart';

final x = iff(a < b, () => a).elseIf(a == b, () => 0).orElse(() => b);
